scf_convergence._note: SCF convergence tightness (ORCA simple-input tiers). ORCAdesk writes no tier unless one is picked: ORCA 6.1.1 then raises Opt/OptTS/IRC to TightSCF itself and runs SP/Freq/TD-DFT at NormalSCF. NOTE: ORCA has no 'MediumSCF' tier — it rejects it as an unrecognized keyword — so it is not offered.
